title: Rate Card Extract — Guest Service Fee Percentage on a Notice Charge
content:
# Rate card extract — guest service fee on a notice charge

**Rate rule.** The guest service fee percentage of the notice charge on a cancelled reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category depends on the stay's fee structure and length: a stay booked with the host-only fee structure carries the host-only-fee guest service fee percentage of its policy; a split-fee stay of 28 nights or more carries the split-fee guest service fee percentage of the stay's policy; any other stay carries 14.20 percent. The fee structure and the number of nights are those recorded on the stay.

## Rates

| Cancellation policy | Host-only fee structure | Split fee, 28 nights or more | Split fee, under 28 nights |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flexible | 0.00% | 14.20% | 14.20% |
| Moderate | 0.00% | 14.20% | 14.20% |
| Limited | 0.00% | 14.20% | 14.20% |
| Firm | 0.00% | 14.20% | 14.20% |
| Strict | 0.00% | 14.20% | 14.20% |
| Super Strict 30 Days | 0.00% | 14.20% | 14.20% |
| Super Strict 60 Days | 0.00% | 14.20% | 14.20% |
| Long-Term | 0.00% | 12.00% | 14.20% |

## Applied to a fee base of 1,000.00 (hypothetical)

| Stay | Percentage | Guest service fee on the notice charge |
|---|---|---|
| host-only fee, 40 nights, Long-Term | 0.00% | 0.00 |
| split fee, 40 nights, Long-Term | 12.00% | 120.00 |
| split fee, 27 nights, Long-Term (shortened by a change) | 14.20% | 142.00 |
| split fee, 10 nights, Moderate | 14.20% | 142.00 |
